query: SELECT c.id, c.status, c.updated_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, c.updated_at, NOW()) as minutes_since_update, a.id as assessment_id, a.created_at as assessment_created FROM claims c LEFT JOIN ai_assessments a ON a.claim_id = c.id WHERE c.id = 6330001 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
